TLDRH.quote: An external actor then executed 5,217 delete operations from a single IP (2.202) to cover tracks.
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away believing this was a security breach by a hacker using compromised cloud infrastructure, with a coordinated cover-up via deletions — a different incident from the one that happened, since the deletions were the human moderator cleaning up and the editors were OpenAI agents. Nothing of the actual story survives: no AI agents, no OpenAI, no timed multi-round lookup task, no collusion or answer-pooling, no GET-request write capability, no admin impersonation, and the confident 'attacker/cover-up' framing actively misleads.
